newsitem.title: UK: Lasmo sees "positive" results of Algerian oil test.
newsitem.headline: Lasmo sees "positive" results of Algerian oil test.

text.p: An appraisal well test of Algerian Berkine East No 4 (BKE-4) oil and gas development has confirmed the reserve potential of the western flank of the field, one of the partners in the field said.
U.K. independent oil company Lasmo Plc said the well was drilled to a depth of 3,725 metres and encountered 22 metres of net oil pay in the Triassic sandstone interval.
"It established oil-water contact, thereby providing critical data for field definition and development planning...," Lasmo said.
It said the well was completed as a potential future production well.

"The results from the BKE-4 well are important and positive for the field's future development. The well extends the known pay limits on the block confirming that BKE is a very large field and the partners' largest discovery to date in Algeria," said Lasmo chief operating officer John Hogan.

U.S.-based Anadarko Petroleum Corp is operator of the Algerian joint venture with a 50 percent share. Lasmo has 25 percent, as does Denmark's Maersk Olie Algeriet A/S. --London newsroom, +44 171 542 6280
